summary: Re-verified fixes for TV/Desktop MegaRadio CountrySelector native keyboard and useDragScroll drag distance. All 3 targeted scenarios now pass end-to-end on the live TV preview. Backend was NOT retested (per request, 100% green in iteration_43).

issues: ~10 station favicons are still served over HTTP (Chrome auto-upgrades to HTTPS; noisy Mixed-Content warnings in console). Same as iteration_43 — not blocking, optional polish via /api/tv-proxy/icon.

countryselector_native_keyboard.evidence: After opening the CountrySelector modal (clicked country chip top-right), typed physical keys g, e, r. Search input displayed 'ger' (searchQuery span text confirmed = 'ger'). Filtered list shrank from 219 to 4 matches (+Global header = 5 visible options): Germany, Algeria, Nigeria, The Niger — Germany option-DE present with 'Ger' highlighted in pink. Backspace reduced query to 'ge' → 6 matches. Escape closed the modal (country-selector-fullpage no longer visible). useNativeKeyboard capture-phase registration is firing before the modal's internal stopPropagation keydown handler as designed.

dragscroll_distance.evidence: On Discover page Popular Genres row (scrollWidth=144876, clientWidth=1580), performed a slow 30-step pointer drag from x=1500 → x=394 (1106 px). scrollLeft changed 0 → 1102 — i.e., the full dragged distance (-4 px rounding) was applied, confirming the window-level pointermove listeners now receive events uninterrupted without setPointerCapture. Previous iteration showed only ~8 px delta.

plain_click_navigation.evidence: A single click (no drag) on a card in the Discover scroller navigated from #/discover-no-user to #/genre-list/community%20supported%20radio%20station — confirming the drag-swallow click handler only engages when moved=true and plain clicks propagate as expected. No click is eaten when pointer doesn't exceed the 6 px lift threshold.

action_items: All 3 re-verification items PASS. No code changes required from main agent.
Optional polish: proxy HTTP station favicons through /api/tv-proxy/icon to eliminate Mixed-Content console warnings (pre-existing, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: useNativeKeyboard.ts correctly threads the new `capture` option through addEventListener/removeEventListener with matching true/false on cleanup, and keeps the skip-on-INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable guard — no regression risk for Search page which omits capture.

useDragScroll.ts correctly registers pointermove/pointerup/pointercancel on window in pointerdown and removes all three in endDrag AND on cleanup; no orphan listeners. The 6 px threshold + is-dragging class + capture-phase click swallow (only when moved=true) is clean.

CountrySelector.tsx: existing document 'keydown' D-pad handler still calls e.stopPropagation() unconditionally, but since useNativeKeyboard now runs in window capture phase it fires first — correct fix.
No file size or DRY violations introduced; all changes are surgical and minimal.
